scope: Scalar geometry and mounting references for the one fixed NeXT Sound Box mini; not an acoustic measurement or verified physical fit.

mounting.eligibility: Full-range only. Opening, frame/recess, mounting, depth-dependent body clearance, terminals, and unmodeled assembly clearances must all be checked. Nominal size or a single depth alone cannot qualify a driver.

air_region.reference_domain: Triangular prism bounded by the measured inner side planes X=+/-40.25 mm, floor Z=3 mm, back Y=29.15 mm, and the virtual front closure at the identified rear grille face. Subtract all four modeled solids; select the connected component containing world point (0,15,15) mm.

alternate_front_domain.definition: Same domain planes with front closure moved to the maximum axial extent of the reference driver.

air_region.acoustic_topology: The as-supplied CAD rear air communicates with the exterior; a physically sealed box or tuned vent is not established.
air_region.profile_use: Geometric reference with explicit virtual closure, unknown remaining displacement, and unknown leakage. Do not publish as a qualified sealed net acoustic volume.

limits: Named empty and generic CAD entries do not establish that every physical component is represented.
The remaining displacement of electronics, connectors, wires, gaskets, and damping has no supplied placed-solid inventory.
A virtual closure defines a repeatable reference region; it does not close physical openings or determine their acoustic impedance.
The alternate front domain is a geometric sensitivity result, not a confidence interval.
Physical printing tolerances, assembly seal, and exact driver revision are not measured.
